entities.summary: Unieście is a coastal village in the administrative district of Gmina Mielno, within Koszalin County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, in north-western Poland. It lies approximately 12 km (7 mi) north-west of Koszalin and 137 km (85 mi) north-east of the regional capital Szczecin.
